blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks fell for a third straight session on Wednesday as concerns over economic growth, rising US Treasury yields, and a weak peso dampened investor sentiment. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) lost 1.03 percent, or 58.92 points, to close at 5,679.48.
